hook.goal: Create an emotional connection with the dinosaur — notice its big teeth, powerful legs, and amazing appearance
hook.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, personal feeling hook, invitational tone

transition.goal: Invite the child to travel back in time with the dinosaur — introduce the what_would_it_say game where they imagine the dinosaur in different time periods
transition.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, explain game simply, end with genuine invitation (Would you like to try?)

rounds.goal: Explore what the dinosaur does in a giant prehistoric jungle with huge trees and ferns
Explore how the dinosaur reacts to a big rumbling volcano with shaking ground
Explore what the dinosaur does at a peaceful lake at sunset, everything calm

celebrate.goal: Celebrate the child as a Time Traveler — they imagined the dinosaur in a jungle, at a volcano, and by a lake; connect to IB concept Change
celebrate.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, name 1 IB concept naturally

closing.goal: Leave the child with a cross-session hook — next time they see their dinosaur friend, imagine other time periods to visit
closing.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, warm and gentle

early_exit.goal: Gentle goodbye — they had an amazing time-travel adventure, the dinosaur had a great time exploring with them
early_exit.constraint: T0 max 2 sentences, no pressure to continue

widget_params.description: Dinosaur photo centered with a prehistoric glow effect
Illustration of a dinosaur in a lush prehistoric jungle
Illustration of a dinosaur near a rumbling volcano
Illustration of a dinosaur resting by a peaceful lake at sunset
